verdict_word: Beat, flattered by a tariff refund
takeaways: Adjusted EPS of CHF 0.54 beat the CHF 0.38 estimate, but a one-off CHF 52.6 million U.S. tariff refund did a lot of the lifting (Investing.com).
Sales of CHF 931.4 million barely cleared the CHF 929.8 million consensus; growth was 17.2% (17.8% in constant currency).
Ex-refund gross margin was 66.9% vs 65.7% a year ago; full-year gross margin outlook now about 67.5% (about 66% ex-refund), up from at least 65%.
Full-year sales growth guidance held at low-20% constant currency (CHF 3.47-3.56 billion); the adjusted EBITDA margin outlook was unchanged.
Americas grew 12.4%, Europe/Middle East/Africa 17.9% and Asia-Pacific 31.1%; direct-to-consumer sales rose 25%.
verdict: On's profit beat came with an asterisk the size of a customs refund check. Strip that out and you get a shoe company growing nicely that didn't raise the guide. The market wanted it to sprint; it jogged.

sources.title: Investing.com: On Holding shares fall 5% premarket as tariff refund flatters Q3 beat
